heading: Assessment before contract for acquisition of supplies is entered into
lead: The Secretary of Defense shall ensure that before a contract for the delivery of supplies to the Department of Defense is entered into—

tree.text: when the appropriate officials of the Department are making an assessment of the most advantageous source for acquisition of the supplies (considering quality, price, delivery, and other factors), there is a review of the availability and cost of each item of supply—

children.text: through the supply system of the Department of Defense; and

under standard Government supply contracts, if the item is in a category of supplies defined under regulations of the Secretary of Defense as being potentially available under a standard Government supply contract; and

tree.text: there is a review of both the procurement history of the item and a description of the item, including, when necessary for an adequate description of the item, a picture, drawing, diagram, or other graphic representation of the item.
